title: Zoho CRM Now Sets Itself Up From One Sentence #Shorts
description:
Zoho CRM now has native customization agents: describe what you need in plain English and the agent builds your profiles, roles, data sharing rules, review processes or segmentation. Turn on Zoho Hosted LLM under Setup › Zia › Models, then click Customize with Agent on the settings page.

1. First, go to Setup, Zia, Models, and turn on Zoho Hosted LLM in the Internal LLM section.
2. Then open the Roles page and click the Zia button, Customize with Agent.
3. Now describe it in plain English, like: create five regional sales roles, each reporting to its own director.
4. Click Authorize Agent the first time, check the roles it builds, and you are done.

- name: Zoho CRM native customization agents
- endpoint: Setup › Zia › Models › Zoho Hosted LLM
- docs: https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/community/topic/introducing-native-agents-configure-your-crm-with-natural-language

story.title: Introducing native agents: Configure your Zoho CRM with natural language
story.summary: Zoho CRM (official community post 'Introducing native agents: Configure your CRM with natural language'): native agents configure CRM settings from natural language - five customization agents: Profiles (profiles + permissions for modules, fields, setup actions), Roles (roles and role hierarchies), Data sharing (sharing rules between roles, users, groups, teams), Review process (review criteria, reviewers, actions), Segmentation (RFM segmentation rules). Each agent = Zia button 'Customize with Agent' on its settings page (e.g. Roles page). Enable: Setup > Zia > Models, Internal LLM section, turn on 'Zoho Hosted LLM'. First use: 'Authorize Agent' once per agent. Example: five regional lead roles, each reporting to a different director, created in one pass. Editions: Professional, Enterprise, Ultimate, Zoho One, CRM Plus; US, IN, EU, AU, JP data centers (others phased).
